UNIVERSAL SOLUTION FOR EVERY SURFACE - Versatile spray restores multiple household materials back to pristine condition

FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)

Q: Does it actually prevent mould from coming back?

A: Yes! It doesn't just clean the surface; it creates a protective barrier that helps slow down mould regrowth. This is especially great for damp areas like bathrooms and baseboards, keeping your walls fresher for longer. 🛡️

Q: Can I use this on different surfaces like bathroom tiles or painted walls?

A: Absolutely. It's highly versatile and perfect for interior walls, bathroom tiles, baseboards, and damp corners. The deep-penetrating formula works on various household surfaces to tackle hidden mould roots. 🏠

Q: Is it safe to use around the house?

A: It's designed for easy household mould cleanup. However, as with any powerful active cleaning formula, we always recommend good ventilation, wearing gloves, and keeping it out of reach of children and pets. (Always patch-test on a small hidden area first if you have delicate surfaces). 🧤

Q: Do I need to scrub the walls after spraying?

A: No heavy scrubbing is required! The fast-acting formula quickly dissolves mould and mildew stains. Just spray, wait, and wipe away to restore clean wall surfaces. 🪄

Compact, easy to use, and effective — this is your go-to spray for keeping walls looking fresh and spotless.

Key Features

  • Compact 100ml Size: Lightweight and easy to handle, perfect for targeted spot-cleaning and quick touch-ups throughout the home.

Brand QIFENGHE
Volume 100ml
Application Spray
Suitable Surfaces Latex walls, painted walls
Target Stains Graffiti, handprints, yellow marks, dirt
High-Concern Chemicals None

  5. Wipe away with a clean, dry cloth or sponge.
  6. Repeat if necessary for stubborn stains.
